name: ground-fleet
notes: The Ground Fleet (plan/human-ground-forces-style-guide.md): per-unit V/W blocks of five authored hull headings (0-90 degrees, mirrored), the articulated layer at five angles, generated overlays and states (plan/ground-unit-animation.md, Section 4), packed per sector with the sector camouflage baked in. Every value is an input to tools/ground_blocks (Go). Phase 0: the atlases are built from the rigs in art/families/rigs/ alone (go run . offline); the GPU pipeline (Qwen-Image-Edit heading redraws from the rig render plus the unit's approved hero, BiRefNet mattes, grid finishing) refines them from Phase 1 (plan/render-runs/ground-forces-rework.md). Colours come only from the reserved sets ally_hull, ally_cyan, ally_crew and smoke of art/families/ground-forces.json; demon_warm and demon_gilt are forbidden.

krybor.note: Snow: top facets one step lighter, skirts dark

ringfall.note: Patch plates: alternating facets one step apart

ember.note: Heat shield: lower hull and skirts at steps 0-1

hollow.note: One teal band across hull and turret (ally_cyan 0-1)

carrier.note: Plain fleet grey; the Carrier sector's own slot is the Skiff (operator default, 2026-11-14)

style_prompt: pixel art, 16-bit arcade game sprite, crisp square pixels, limited palette, original artwork, centered, isolated, solid flat magenta background (#FF00FF), no checkerboard, single vehicle seen from behind and above, three-quarter top view, night lighting, rim light from upper left, flat faceted grey-blue armour plates with chamfered corners, panel seams, rivet rows, side skirts, thin glowing cyan light strips along the edges, cyan visor slit, no warm lights, clean frontier military engineering, chunky readable silhouette
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, ui, frame, border, blurry, photo, photorealistic, smooth gradient, multiple views, character sheet, grid, sky, horizon, ground, landscape, scenery, crowd, many objects, red lights, orange lights, warm glow, gold, fire, horns, face, teeth, spikes, hooks, pointed arch, stone, organic, insect, camouflage pattern, flags, national insignia, real military vehicle
